answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds agent identities to a quadratic stake-burning auction where registering $k$ identities requires burning $O(k^2)$ cryptographic tokens. Like a sand dune shifting against artificial manipulation, this superlinear cost scaling destroys attacker capital exponentially faster than any coordinated plume of fake entities can extract value, ensuring only genuine autonomous participants can harbor state and voting rights in the consensus layer.
